articles.title: We Calculated How Many Hot Dogs Fit Inside the World's Largest Hot Dog Sculpture—and It's a Lot
articles.summary: The 65-foot hot dog sculpture is back in NYC. With 6,000 cubic feet of interior space and an 80% packing efficiency, you could cram in about 1.75 million real wieners.

articles.title: NASA's CAPSTONE 02 Will Test Autonomous Docking and Formation Flying Around the Moon
articles.summary: Launching in 2027, CAPSTONE 02 will use two small spacecraft to demonstrate rendezvous and proximity operations in lunar orbit, paving the way for crewed Artemis landings.

articles.title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4 Goes Full Jurassic with Dinosaurs and Lovecraftian Horror
articles.summary: Showrunners Henry Alonso Myers and Akiva Goldsman reveal Season 4's genre-bending episodes, from dinosaur encounters to a haunted starship, now streaming on Paramount+.
